text.en: 1. This Order is the Environmental Public Health (Specified Construction Sites) Order 2021 and comes into operation on 30 September 2021.
3. Section 62 of the Act applies to any construction site, the contract sum in relation to which exceeds $10 million (called in this Order a specified construction site).

heading.en: Appointment of Environmental Control Officer for specified construction site

text.en:
4.—(1) A registered Environmental Control Officer required to be appointed for a specified construction site under section 62(2) or (2A) of the Act —
(a)where the contract sum for the specified construction site exceeds $50 million — must be appointed on a full‑time basis; or
(b)where the contract sum for the specified construction site exceeds $10 million but does not exceed $50 million — may be appointed on a part‑time basis or full‑time basis.
(2) In this paragraph —
“full‑time basis”, for the appointment of a registered Environmental Control Officer for a specified construction site, means the appointment of the Environmental Control Officer to carry out his or her function as such for the specified construction site for at least 40 hours per week;
“part‑time basis”, for the appointment of a registered Environmental Control Officer for a specified construction site, means the appointment of the Environmental Control Officer to carry out his or her function as such for the specified construction site for at least 15 hours per week.
5. The Environmental Public Health (Appointment of Environmental Control Officers) Order (O 1) is revoked.
